rkgn8h: Send it again. Same input. Over.

9yz3t9: Without brackets it reads six minus two minus four, a subtraction. The two has to multiply the whole minus four.
r8sxff: Evaluate. Two lots of minus four is minus eight. Six take away minus eight is fourteen.

cuomiv: Now, exam style. The tower's battery bank charges off a solar panel. The charge, in percent, t hours after sunrise, is C of t equals twenty plus twelve t, for t from zero to six.
wjnpvb: Part a. Write down C of zero, and say what it means. Zero hours is sunrise, so C of zero is twenty. Twenty percent at sunrise, not an empty battery.
nr0gxp: Part b. Find C of five. Yours. Over.

exxlak: Five goes in for t. Twelve lots of five, then add twenty. Come in again.
814c8q: Part c. Find the time when it's at seventy-four percent.
kpmso6: Output. Seventy-four is a charge. The time is the input, and that's what they want.
3lrx6r: Crossed wire. Seventy-four is a charge, and charge is what comes out. t is what you're finding.
m3jh3m: So C of t equals seventy-four, and solve for t. Twenty off both sides: fifty-four equals twelve t. Divide by twelve. t is four point five.
a13oav: Four and a half hours after sunrise. Inside zero to six, so the model holds. Check: twelve lots of four point five is fifty-four, plus twenty, seventy-four. Out.
